podcast.body: In 1967, the Smothers Brothers performed this classic anti-war folk song with guest star George Segal on their show, aligning with their public stance against the Vietnam War. "Here they are in 1967 with guest star George Segal, performing the classic anti-war folk song, Draft Dodger Rag."
